applies_why: The judge text issues a RESULT of DEFENDER WINS, which is the decision the rule governs.
quote: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with "dates the finding" and "bounds the stated abstinence," so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.
rule_words: HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.
room: A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count: read as (1) the standing is excluded entirely once its stated reason is retracted, or (2) only the retracted reason is ignored while other support may remain; the text supplies no other support.
why: The only stated basis for non-self-supported standing is the C3 broken collision, and the only CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN grade is retracted, so neither condition for DEFENDER WINS remains valid.
